en.bdb: The fickle-minded and the adulteress woman

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੁ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਪਲਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਲਜ ਨ ਲਜਾ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: saahur peehar palarai hoi nilaj na lajaa dhovai|

en.bdb: Abandoning both the families of father and father-in-laws, the shameless woman cares not for modesty and does not wish to wash away her immoral reputation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵੈ ਜਾਰੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾਣਿ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: raavai jaar bhataar taj khi(n)jotaan khusee kiau hovai|

en.bdb: Deserting her husband, if she enjoys the company of her paramour, how can she, moving in different lustful directions, be happy?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਮਝਾਈ ਨਾ ਸਮਝਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ਪਰਣੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: samajhaiee naa samajhahee marane parane lok vigovai|

en.bdb: No advice prevails upon her and she is despised at all social gatherings of mourning and rejoicing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਿਰਿ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਮੇਹਣੇ ਹੁਇ ਸਰਮਿੰਦੀ ਅੰਝੂ ਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhir dhir miladhe mehane hui sarami(n)dhee a(n)jhoo rovai|

en.bdb: She weeps in contrition because she is disdaifully reproached at every door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਹਾਣਿ ਕਾਣਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਖੜੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paap kamaane pakaReeaai haan kaan dheebaan khaRovai|

en.bdb: For her sins, she is arrested and punished by the court where she loses every iota of honour that she had.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: marai na jeevai dhukh sahai rahai na ghar vich par ghar jovai|

en.bdb: She is miserable because now she is neither dead nor alive; she still looks for another house to ruin because she does not like to live in her own home.
Similarly doubt or double-mindedness weaves for it the garland of vices.
